description: Checks an estimate you got earlier. Returns whether it is still valid, when it expires, whether a full quote was requested and how many revisions are left. Takes the token from the estimate's status_url. The token expires with the estimate: a bad or expired one returns an error (400) and a new estimate is needed. Numbers are changed with preliminary_estimate (revises) and handed to a person with request_full_quote.

token.description: The token from the estimate's status_url

name: estimate_status

full_quote_requested.description: Whether a full quote was requested

revision.description: How many times it was revised

valid_until.description: Date the estimate is valid until

title: Check estimate status
